#1 I have created this personal page to briefly introduce my academic background, research interests, and contributions to the nLab.

I am currently a graduate student at New York University Abu Dhabi, working on homotopy type theory, higher category theory, and AI-assisted mathematical formalization.

I hope to use this page to document my ongoing mathematical work and contributions to the nLab community.

Hongwei Wang
